verdict.rationale: Granola documents a native HubSpot integration that automatically saves notes added to Granola folders onto the relevant HubSpot contacts, companies, or deals (granola-docs-39, granola-docs-10, granola-docs-18). Sync is triggered by filing notes into folders rather than happening automatically per meeting. The evidence shows no native Salesforce or Attio sync; generic Zapier automation and the API are building blocks, not this capability. Missing for 10: native Salesforce and Attio sync, fully automatic matching of meetings to records without folder setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of HubSpot record matching.
